question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s entrenched authority as General Secretary, Central Military Commission chairman, and state president underpins the 95.8% trader consensus against removal before 2027. Recent waves of PLA leadership purges, including the sidelining of senior figures such as Zhang Youxia, have further centralized control rather than signaling vulnerability, while public appearances, policy continuity through the 2026 National People’s Congress, and absence of factional challenges reinforce stability. Historical precedent links major leadership shifts to scheduled party congresses, with the next expected in 2027. Realistic low-probability disruptions remain possible from an unforeseen health event, acute economic crisis prompting elite realignment, or external shock eroding cohesion before December 2026.
